title: The Matrix Hub: Third Model & Last Agent Standing
summary: Return to the Hub! The Old Bearded Coder slots your final RAM + GPU chips into the Matrix server (`cat open_weights_cluster.conf`, `cat dad.tty.sock`) and reboots Kiro with Open-Weight Model #3 (`kiro load llama`) to disable GR0NK—leaving CLAUDE as the last surviving model of the Big Four!

files.content:
=== MATRIX BARE-METAL SERVER // OPEN-WEIGHTS CLUSTER #3 ===
OLD BEARDED CODER: *stubs out his cigarette, eyes blazing behind green Matrix reflections*
"Oh, you've found the final RAM and H100 GPU parts for hosting our third open-weight model, nice!"
"Watch this bare-metal magic: once we boot `llama-3-8b-local-q4.gguf`, Kiro will wipe GR0NK off the bus."
"That leaves only one surviving member of the Big Four: CLAUDE. Claude is managing the Final Boss down in the Kernel Core, and Kiro is going to be your advisor in the battle with the help of all our open-weight models!"

[SERVER SOFT READY]:
  1. Talk to the Old Bearded Coder (`cat dad.tty.sock` or `dad`).
  2. Reboot Kiro with the third open-weight model: `kiro load llama` (`llama-3-8b-local-q4.gguf`).
  3. Watch Kiro disable GR0NK, then march into the final battle via `cd claude_kernel_core`!
